name: upy-gen-driver-plugin
description: Workflow plugin phase for generating missing MicroPython hardware drivers from datasheets, Arduino source, GitHub URLs, chip model names, or current project cold-driver items.

interface.shortDescription: Generate a missing MicroPython hardware driver.
interface.longDescription: Runs upy-gen-driver-plugin in standalone or pipeline mode with session checkpoints, retry, timeout, cancellation, permission prompts, structured errors, and artifact manifests.
defaultPrompt: Generate a missing MicroPython driver from a datasheet or Arduino source.
Run upy-gen-driver-plugin for the current project's cold-driver item.
